preconditions.description: The integer n must be between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each value f(i) must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid else True
postconditions.description: If no valid m, g, and h exist, output -1.
The integer m must be between 1 and 1000000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(g[i] in range(1, m + 1) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each value g(i) must be an integer between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(h[j] in range(1, n + 1) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each value h(j) must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(g[h[j] - 1] == j + 1 for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The condition g(h(x)) = x must hold for all x in [m].

postconditions.expression: all(h[g[i] - 1] == f[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The condition h(g(x)) = f(x) must hold for all x in [n].
